PullRequest.Title: Notify when sandboxing dependencies are not present on Windows
PullRequest.Body:

Fixes #338980

## Summary

- Remove the Linux-only gate from SDK sandbox diagnostics so Windows and macOS sessions publish unsupported-host reasons during initialization and sandbox configuration updates.
- Make chat input notification text selectable and render HTTP/HTTPS support URLs as clickable links using the shared link detector. Escape SDK prose and keep markdown untrusted so embedded markup and command links are not activated.
- Update accessibility help and cover link destinations, mouse/keyboard activation, selectable text, platform diagnostics, and the existing session notification lifecycle.

This preserves sandbox enforcement, custom-terminal handling, session scoping, and dismissal behavior. It does not move support detection to the client or show diagnostics before SDK session initialization in the empty new-session composer.

## Validation

Merged the latest fetched `origin/main` before validation.

- Focused tests: **54 passing**. The initial run exposed two stale platform query-count expectations; corrected them to account for initialization, first send, and configuration refresh, then reran successfully.

```powershell
.\scripts\test.bat --run src\vs\platform\agentHost\test\node\copilotAgentSession.test.ts --run src\vs\workbench\contrib\chat\test\browser\widget\input\chatInputNotificationWidget.test.ts --run src\vs\workbench\contrib\chat\test\browser\agentSessions\agentHostSandboxNotification.test.ts --run src\vs\workbench\contrib\chat\test\browser\agentSessions\agentHostClientTools.test.ts --grep "ChatInputNotificationWidget|AgentHostSandboxNotification|shows sandbox diagnostics|sandbox diagnostic"
```

- Existing `Core - Transpile` task (`npm run watch-client-transpiled`): **0 errors**.
- Existing `Core - Typecheck` task (`npm run watch-clientd`): **0 errors**.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: **passed**.
- Commit hooks (`npm run -s precommit`): **passed** for both implementation and test-expectation commits.
- Full test suite and manual end-to-end UI validation were not rerun for this PR.

## Manual verification

1. On a Windows host where the SDK reports unsupported sandbox capabilities, enable Windows sandboxing and initialize an Agent Host Copilot session by sending a message.
2. Verify the sandbox-unavailable warning shows the SDK explanation.
3. Select/copy the warning text and open its support URL by clicking or using Tab and Enter.
4. Dismiss the warning and verify it stays dismissed for the session; verify unrelated sessions remain unaffected.

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: The added query count, 5-second timeout, and prompt-critical call chain are all directly established by repository code and the changed test. Actual RPC duration varies by host, but the repeated boundary call and its placement before dispatch are not assumptions.
Findings.PerformanceResource: SDK control-plane RPC calls to sandbox.getHostSupport
Findings.PerformanceScaling: On Windows and macOS with SDK sandboxing enabled, one additional host-support RPC is issued for initialization, for every subsequent prompt, and for each sandbox configuration refresh; cost therefore grows linearly with turns per session and independently across live sessions.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: Blocked prompt dispatch and session initialization, with up to 5 seconds of added latency for each slow or hung query.
Findings.PreviousBehavior: The deleted platform guard passed `{ enabled: false }` to `CopilotSandboxDiagnostics.update` on Windows and macOS, so those paths cleared diagnostics without invoking `sandbox.getHostSupport`; the updated test's prior expectation was zero queries.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: The changed line now passes the enabled sandbox configuration on Windows and macOS. `CopilotSandboxDiagnostics.update` consequently awaits `client.rpc.sandbox.getHostSupport()`, and this method is reached from `_prepareSdkTurn` before `session.send` on every normal prompt.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: At RIGHT line 5171 the PR removes `_platform !== 'linux' ||` from the condition, changing Windows/macOS from `{ enabled: false }` (no probe) to the enabled `sandboxConfig` (probe). The accompanying changed test updates `queries: 0` to `queries: 3` for exactly those platforms.
Findings.Title: Avoid re-querying host support before every prompt
Findings.Impact: A Windows or macOS user with sandboxing enabled can wait for a redundant SDK support probe before every message reaches the agent. If the RPC stalls, the existing 5-second timeout is paid on every turn as well as during session startup.
Findings.Evidence: `_send` awaits `_prepareSdkTurn` before calling `this._wrapper.session.send`; `_prepareSdkTurn` awaits `_applyEffectiveSandboxConfig`, which reaches this changed call. `CopilotSandboxDiagnostics.update` awaits `raceTimeout(this._getHostSupport(), 5_000)` whenever `config.enabled` is true and has no memoization. The changed platform test explicitly observes three queries from initialization, one send, and one root-config refresh, while its pre-diff expectation was zero.
Findings.Recommendation: Cache/coalesce successful host-support results per live SDK session and recompute config-specific reasons from that result, or skip the diagnostic update when the effective sandbox config is unchanged. Preserve explicit refresh on real sandbox configuration changes and allow failed/timed-out probes to retry without putting an identical probe on every prompt.

Scenarios.Scenario: Initialize an Agent Host Copilot session on Windows or macOS with SDK sandboxing enabled
Scenarios.CriticalPath: `CopilotAgent._initializeAndRegisterSession` awaits `initializeSession`; after SDK launch, the changed initialization call awaits `CopilotSandboxDiagnostics.update`, which awaits host-support detection before registration and progress to the remaining initialization work.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One query per initialized live session when the effective SDK sandbox is enabled.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Windows and macOS passed `{ enabled: false }`, so diagnostics cleared without issuing this query.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited directly during initialization; a slow query delays session registration by its duration, bounded by the 5-second timeout.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: SDK session launch/resume and existing initialization RPCs
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing launch and setup operations once per session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same SDK launch/setup boundaries existed before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Already on initialization's critical path; unchanged by this diff.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of Windows/macOS Agent Host sessions initialized with platform sandbox enablement on; one new support query per session.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Each session awaits its own query; there is no cross-session limiter or shared cache, so independently initialized sessions may probe concurrently.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No positive or negative host-support cache exists in `CopilotSandboxDiagnostics`; every enabled update calls the SDK. Diagnostic metadata publication itself is deduplicated by comparing reason arrays.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the removed platform guard, awaited call chain, timeout, and changed query-count test establish the mechanism directly.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Normal support-query latency is not measured, but the code explicitly allows a 5-second timeout and tests the hung-query path.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable as part of the repeated uncached query finding because this adds an awaited initialization RPC on Windows/macOS.

Scenarios.Scenario: Send a normal chat prompt on Windows or macOS with SDK sandboxing enabled
Scenarios.CriticalPath: `send` awaits `_send`, which awaits `_prepareSdkTurn`; that awaits `_applyEffectiveSandboxConfig`, and the changed line awaits diagnostics before `_send` can invoke `session.send`. The support query is therefore on every prompt's pre-dispatch critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing update per normal prompt, serialized per session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The options update already ran before every turn.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Awaited before prompt dispatch, but this operation and placement predate the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: SDK `sandbox.getHostSupport()` query immediately after the sandbox update
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One newly enabled query per normal prompt on Windows/macOS; the changed test observes initialization + send + refresh as three calls.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The prior platform guard passed a disabled config on Windows/macOS, which skipped the query entirely.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Prompt dispatch cannot reach `session.send` until this query resolves or reaches the 5-second timeout.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One dispatch per normal prompt after preflight.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Prompt dispatch began after existing preflight without a Windows/macOS host-support diagnostic query.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The newly enabled support query delays when this existing request can begin.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of prompts across sandbox-enabled Windows/macOS sessions; each prompt adds one query regardless of unchanged host capability or unchanged config.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: `_sandboxConfigSequencer` serializes sandbox work within one session. Separate live sessions have separate sequencers and can issue probes concurrently.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No caching or unchanged-config fast path exists for support results. Successful, unsupported, failed, and timed-out probes are queried again on the next prompt; only published metadata is deduplicated afterward.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: Very high: call ordering and repeated cardinality are explicit, and the timeout test confirms sending waits for diagnostic timeout.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Fast local RPCs may add little latency, while slow/hung runtime queries add up to five seconds per prompt; prevalence of slow hosts is unknown.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable performance regression: redundant unchanged host-support work is newly placed before every prompt for Windows/macOS.

Scenarios.Scenario: Apply root or session configuration changes while a sandbox-enabled Windows/macOS session is live
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The configuration listeners call `_syncPermissionModeAfterConfigChange`, which awaits `_applyEffectiveSandboxConfig`; this applies SDK sandbox options and then awaits the changed diagnostics call. This work is asynchronous relative to unrelated idle UI, but can contend with the per-session sequencer and is awaited by relevant config synchronization.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One per listener-triggered sandbox reconciliation; root change handling can run even for unrelated root configuration changes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The options update already occurred on these refresh paths.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing boundary serialized with turn sandbox preflight.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One added query after each successful enabled reconciliation on Windows/macOS.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No Windows/macOS diagnostic query was made.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Extends sequencer occupancy and delays completion of configuration reconciliation; queued turns wait behind it.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of root/session configuration events and active sandbox-enabled sessions; work is per affected live session/event rather than globally coalesced.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Serialized with prompt sandbox work within each session, independent across sessions; bursts can fan out across live sessions depending on configuration service delivery.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No coalescing based on identical support state or effective config. Reason publication is deduplicated only after the query.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High, corroborated by the changed test's third query after `fireRootConfigChange()`.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Configuration-event frequency and number of simultaneously live sessions vary; the extra boundary and sequencer occupancy are certain.
Scenarios.Verdict: Contributes to the same repeated-query finding; no separate finding because the mechanism and fix are identical.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render and interact with a sandbox-unavailable notification containing support URLs
Scenarios.CriticalPath: A session metadata change invokes `AgentHostSandboxNotification._update`; changed reasons are synchronously scanned for links and converted to `MarkdownString`, then notification service change causes the active chat input widget to rebuild and render markdown. This is off the prompt-dispatch path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Total characters and lines in the small SDK diagnostic reason set, multiplied only by distinct reason changes and visible notification widget renders.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous UI-thread processing, but notification updates are serialized by the event loop and reason-array equality suppresses unchanged updates.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: `_reasons` equality avoids recomputing links for unchanged diagnostics; the notification service replaces one session-scoped entry, and dismissal state is retained in a window-lifetime `WeakMap` keyed by the service.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that the new scan and markdown render occur, low that their bounded input creates a material regression.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: SDK reason length is not formally capped, but expected cardinality is host-level reason plus a small capability list; no realistic large-input trigger is established.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: the new CPU/DOM work is linear in a small, deduplicated diagnostic payload and runs only when reasons change or the widget rerenders.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open chat accessibility help and select notification text
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The help text change only adds localized prose when accessibility help content is assembled; the CSS change alters selection behavior without adding layout reads, writes, timers, or boundaries.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant one additional sentence fragment and two CSS declarations.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous constant work when help is requested or styles are applied; no repeated boundary or scheduling change.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all eight changed files and complete diff pages. One high-confidence repeated-work regression was submitted: Windows/macOS now perform an uncached, awaited SDK host-support query during initialization, every normal prompt, and configuration refresh, with a 5-second timeout on the prompt critical path. Linkification/markdown, CSS, accessibility text, and tests add only bounded or non-production work.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
